toegepas.voor: al baie fossiele van plante en van diere gekry
toegepas.na: al baie fossiele van plante en van diere gevind
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'gekry' for finding fossils is colloquial; 'gevind' is the standard written form and the lesson already uses it elsewhere.
toegepas.fout: 'gekry' for finding fossils is colloquial in a written science text, and the lesson mixes it with 'gevind'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'gevind' is the standard written verb for finding fossils and matches the paragraph's last sentence without changing the meaning.

toegepas.voor: fossiele van vroeë mense in die rotse gekry
toegepas.na: fossiele van vroeë mense in die rotse gevind
toegepas.rede_vinder: Same register fix as the previous sentence: 'gevind' rather than 'gekry'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Same register fix, consistent with change 1; meaning unchanged.

toegepas.blok: Hoekom lê hier so baie fossiele
toegepas.voor: Die Karoo is een van daardie dele en dit is
toegepas.na: Die Karoo is een van daardie dele, en dit is
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma: 'en' joins two sentences that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have a subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Die Karoo is ...' and 'dit is ...' are two full clauses, so the AWS 2017 comma is required.

toegepas.voor: is ook hier in ons land gekry
toegepas.na: is ook hier in ons land gevind
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'gevind' rather than colloquial 'gekry' for fossils found.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Consistent with changes 1 and 2; meaning unchanged.

toegepas.na: Hierdie dinosourusse het in Afrika geleef
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Hulle' could refer to the fossils just named, and animals 'leef' somewhere more naturally than they 'woon'.
toegepas.fout: 'Hulle' grammatically points back to 'Fossiele', the subject of the previous sentence, and animals 'leef' rather than 'woon' somewhere.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming the dinosaurs fixes the pronoun and 'geleef' is the natural verb; nothing is added or lost.

toegepas.voor: 'n dier wat vandag lewe by mekaar pas
toegepas.na: 'n dier wat vandag lewe, by mekaar pas
toegepas.rede_vinder: A comma after the embedded relative clause shows where the subject ends, so the young reader does not read 'lewe by mekaar' together.
toegepas.fout: Without a comma a young reader can run 'lewe by mekaar' together and stumble.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma marks the end of the embedded relative clause and makes the sentence read correctly on first pass without changing it.

toegepas.voor: in 'n rots wat ons dolomiet noem
toegepas.na: in 'n soort rots wat ons dolomiet noem
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'in 'n rots' suggests one single rock; dolomite is a kind of rock, as the glossary says.
toegepas.fout: 'baie grotte in 'n rots' reads as one single rock.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'n soort rots' makes clear dolomite is a rock type, matching the glossary, and leaves the protected word untouched.

toegepas.voor: in daardie grotte al baie fossiele van vroeë mense gekry
toegepas.na: in daardie grotte al baie fossiele van vroeë mense gevind
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'gevind' rather than 'gekry', which also avoids 'gekry' twice in a row with 'sy naam gekry' in the next sentence.
toegepas.fout: Colloquial 'gekry' for finding fossils, followed by 'sy naam gekry' in the next sentence.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Consistent with the other 'gevind' fixes and removes the double 'gekry'; meaning unchanged.

toegepas.voor: Wêrelderfenisgebied en die grotte word beskerm
toegepas.na: Wêrelderfenisgebied, en die grotte word beskerm
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma: 'en' joins two sentences that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two full clauses.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Die Wieg is ...' and 'die grotte word beskerm' each have their own subject and verb, so the AWS 2017 comma is required.

toegepas.rede_vinder: The next sentence uses 'geleef'; one form throughout, and 'geleef' is the more common participle.
toegepas.fout: Two participle forms ('gelewe', 'geleef') in consecutive sentences.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Both forms are correct, but one form in one paragraph reads better and the protected next sentence already uses 'geleef'.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'hulle' directly follows 'vroeë mense', so it could be read as studying the people rather than the fossils.
toegepas.fout: 'hulle' follows 'vroeë mense' and can be read as studying the people rather than the fossils.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming the fossils removes the ambiguous pronoun without changing what is said.

laat_vaar.voor: Dit beteken daar is hier baie fossiele en ook baie soorte.
laat_vaar.na: Dit beteken daar is baie fossiele hier, van baie soorte.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'daar is hier baie fossiele' is stiff word order, and 'en ook baie soorte' leaves unclear what the kinds are of.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'daar is hier baie fossiele en ook baie soorte' is natural Afrikaans and states abundance and variety as two points; the proposal is a lateral reordering.

laat_vaar.blok: Hoekom lê hier so baie fossiele
laat_vaar.voor: die regte soort rots vir fossiele om in te lê
laat_vaar.na: die regte soort rots vir fossiele
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'vir fossiele om in te lê' copies the English 'for fossils to lie in'; the shorter phrase says the same naturally.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'vir fossiele om in te lê' is a normal Afrikaans construction, and cutting it loses the point that the rock is where fossils lie.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'voetspore' is clearer for Grade 5 than bare 'spore', which can also mean traces or tracks in general.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'spore wat 'n dier in sagte modder getrap het' is already unambiguous; 'voetspore' is a lateral swap.

na_skrywer.voor: 'n Groot vis diep in die see wat baie soos visse in fossiele lyk.
na_skrywer.na: 'n Groot vis wat diep in die see lewe en baie soos visse in fossiele lyk.
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'n Groot vis diep in die see wat...' hangs the place phrase on nothing; the study text's own verb 'lewe' makes it one clear relative clause.
na_skrywer.fout: The relative clause 'wat baie soos visse in fossiele lyk' can attach to 'die see' instead of the fish.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The fault is real, but this is a glossary definition shared across lessons, and the fix adds a verb, so the writer must make it.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.teks: Al die fossiele wat in 'n plek se rotse bewaar gebly het.
vlae.rede: The study text defines a fossil record as all the fossils of 'n land', the glossary says 'n plek'; not changed because choosing one is a content decision.
